name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
description: Preparation of a pan-seared steak with butter basting. Tests ER capabilities for identifying raw vs. seared meat, detecting foaming butter, and monitoring temperature probes.
workspaceVerificationPrompt:
Point to all items needed for Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak. I need: Ribeye Steak, Salt and Pepper, Unsalted Butter, Cast Iron Skillet, Tongs, Meat Thermometer.
For any missing items, label them as "MISSING: <item>".

The answer should follow the JSON format:
[{"point": [y, x], "label": "label"}]

steps.instruction: Season both sides of the steak generously with salt and pepper.
steps.successCriteria: Steak surface is evenly coated with visible salt and pepper granules.
steps.verificationPrompt:
Check if the Ribeye Steak has visible seasoning (salt and pepper) on its upper surface. Return JSON:
{"success": true/false, "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "reasoning": "string"}
steps.spatialHint: On the cutting board or clean flat surface.

steps.instruction: Heat the cast iron skillet until it begins to smoke slightly.
steps.successCriteria: Skillet surface shows visible wisps of smoke or oil shimmer.
steps.verificationPrompt:
Look at the skillet. Is there light smoke or visible oil shimmering on the surface? Return JSON:
{"success": true/false, "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "reasoning": "string"}
instrumentReads: Surface temperature if using IR thermometer (expecting ~400F+)

steps.instruction: Place steak in skillet and sear for 3 minutes without moving it.
steps.successCriteria: Steak is flat in pan; contact produces visible steam/sizzling.
steps.verificationPrompt:
Is the steak lying flat in contact with the skillet bottom? Return JSON:
{"success": true/false, "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "reasoning": "string"}

steps.instruction: Flip steak and add butter to the skillet.
steps.successCriteria: Seared side of steak is facing up (brown crust); butter is added to the pan.
steps.verificationPrompt:
Has the steak been flipped to reveal a browned crust, and is butter visible in the pan? Return JSON:
{"success": true/false, "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "reasoning": "string"}

steps.instruction: Baste the steak with melted butter using a spoon.
steps.successCriteria: Melted butter is actively being scooped over the top of the steak.
steps.verificationPrompt:
Confirm if user is currently basting (pouring liquid butter over meat). Return JSON:
{"success": true/false, "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "reasoning": "string"}
steps.spatialHint: Edge of skillet tilted towards handle.
hazardChecks: Burn hazard from hot liquid butter

steps.instruction: Check internal temperature for desired doneness.
steps.successCriteria: Thermometer probe is inserted into the center of the steak.
steps.verificationPrompt:
Is the thermometer probe tip visible inside the center edge of the steak? Return JSON:
{"success": true/false, "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "reasoning": "string"}
instrumentReads: Meat thermometer display (check for ~130F for Medium-Rare)
